findings.title: Workflow and supply-chain parser can skip unsupported syntax
findings.reproduction_input: A workflow containing quoted, anchored, aliased, commented, or malformed uses keys, a hidden mutable ref, or a Full command only inside a comment.
findings.expected_failure_reason: Source-string matching does not parse a deliberately restricted workflow grammar and can silently skip authority or verification drift.
findings.h_rereview_criterion: Every named workflow mutation exits nonzero with its intended diagnostic class, while the tracked workflow passes locally without claiming hosted CI.

resolution.focused_verification: Windows CI contract and 12 restricted-grammar mutations passed.

findings.title: pnpm cache producer and consumer are not bound to resolved workspace configuration
findings.reproduction_input: A workspace config redirects storeDir or node_modules, or a workflow introduces a second pnpm store producer with a different resolved path.
findings.expected_failure_reason: The existing check does not combine workspace configuration, resolved store path, and producer count, so cache identity can drift.
findings.h_rereview_criterion: Resolved producer and consumer paths are identical and in policy; redirection and duplicate-producer mutations fail closed.

resolution.focused_verification: pnpm producer/consumer contract and redirect/duplicate mutations passed.

findings.title: Escaped Unicode placeholders can bypass raw JSON scanning
findings.reproduction_input: A JSON string encodes a placeholder with Unicode escapes, duplicates or leaves a declaration unused, or contains malformed placeholder delimiters.
findings.expected_failure_reason: Scanning undecoded JSON text does not operate on the semantic string value and can miss escaped placeholders or declaration inconsistencies.
findings.h_rereview_criterion: JSON is decoded before placeholder validation and escaped, duplicate, unused, undeclared, and malformed mutations each fail with the intended reason.

resolution.focused_verification: Decoded placeholder contract and escaped/duplicate/unused/malformed mutations passed.

findings.title: Task log records can carry invalid or contradictory completion evidence
findings.reproduction_input: A record omits a critical key, uses a non-finite duration or invalid UTC timestamp, invents a status, or disagrees with its index row.
findings.expected_failure_reason: Loose text checks cannot prove typed time, duration, status, and record-to-index equality and can accept false completion claims.
findings.h_rereview_criterion: Critical keys and typed values are enforced and every index status exactly matches the referenced record under positive and negative tests.

resolution.focused_verification: Typed task-log contract and missing/time/status/index mutations passed for 58 records.

findings.title: Rust public authority can escape incomplete visibility inventory
findings.reproduction_input: A public union, extern item, type, static, constant, re-export, glob re-export, or hidden public module is added outside the required facade.
findings.expected_failure_reason: The existing visibility scan does not cover the full Rust public syntax surface or fail closed on unknown syntax and facade omissions.
findings.h_rereview_criterion: All named public forms and unknown syntax are inventoried; forbidden or unfacaded authority fails with a precise diagnostic.

resolution.focused_verification: Rust authority visibility contract and public-form mutations passed.

findings.title: Process authority inventory is not bidirectional or function-scope aware
findings.reproduction_input: A ninth Command or Popen call is added, a registration points at the wrong function, or a stale registration has no matching callsite.
findings.expected_failure_reason: File-level or one-way matching can miss a process spawn or accept a registration owned by a different function.
findings.h_rereview_criterion: Every discovered spawn maps to exactly one registered owning function and every registration maps back to the correct concrete callsite.

resolution.focused_verification: Eight registered process callsites and bidirectional ownership mutations passed.

findings.title: SAFE evidence does not exercise the actual command failure paths
findings.reproduction_input: The production command encounters staging cleanup failure, lowercase SHA reread, or a competing destination appears during failure cleanup.
findings.expected_failure_reason: Helper-only tests do not prove command wiring, hash normalization, or that failure cleanup preserves a competing target.
findings.h_rereview_criterion: Actual command-path regressions prove lowercase reread acceptance, staging cleanup diagnostics, and non-deletion of a competing destination.

resolution.focused_verification: Production draft-export command races, cleanup failure and lowercase SHA regressions passed.

findings.title: DATA lifecycle declarations are not bound to production functions and storage joins
findings.reproduction_input: A lifecycle declaration names the wrong function, omits an actual storage join, or claims a join that production cannot reach.
findings.expected_failure_reason: Forward declarations without reverse discovery can drift away from the functions and path joins that own data.
findings.h_rereview_criterion: Bidirectional mutations bind every declaration to the exact production function and storage join, with no undisclosed or stale mapping.

resolution.focused_verification: Bidirectional data-lifecycle declarations and wrong-owner/join mutations passed.

findings.title: Counterfactual RESULT measurements can be mistaken for production evidence
findings.reproduction_input: A synthetic counterfactual measurement is labeled production, or metadata validation asserts a hardcoded boolean instead of bounded values.
findings.expected_failure_reason: Current labels and assertions do not prove evidence provenance or the intended metadata bounds.
findings.h_rereview_criterion: Counterfactual data is explicitly non-production and boundary tests validate numeric and metadata ranges rather than a fixed boolean.

resolution.focused_verification: Counterfactual result provenance and bounded metadata tests passed.
